description: Scrape trending and popular YouTube videos by category. Supports Gaming, News, Music, Movies, and Now Trending sections with regional market targeting.

category.description: Which YouTube trending section to scrape. 'Gaming', 'News', and 'Music' work without authentication. 'Now' (main trending feed) and 'Movies' are auth-gated for cookieless requests and automatically use a clearly labeled public search fallback instead of returning nothing.
category.title: Category

market.description: Country/region for localized trending results. Sets the gl URL parameter to target the correct regional trending feed.
market.title: Market / Region

maxResults.description: Maximum number of trending videos to return. YouTube Gaming typically surfaces 200-400 videos across all shelf sections.
maxResults.title: Max Results

title: YouTube Trending Scraper Input
